scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Ordered pairwise-commuting idempotent triples of the classical Catalan monoid for every chain length; total, product-rank and four-way joint-rank enumerators.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No higher-arity or nonidempotent count; prior published pair criterion and abstract semilattice-homomorphism characterization are acknowledged; historical priority remains provisional.

title: Quartic triple-commutation law and joint-rank transfer for Catalan monoids
